messages.text: Barcola set to sign Liverpool contract to 2031

metadata.summary: Bradley Barcola is set sign a Liverpool contract to 2031 after the Premier League club reached agreement with PSG over the structure of the transfer.
metadata.content: Bradley Barcola set to sign Liverpool contract to 2031 after PSG agree transfer worth up to £123m | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Transfer Bradley Barcola set to sign Liverpool contract to 2031 after PSG agree transfer worth up to £123m Liverpool reached a £120m deal in principle earlier this week to sign PSG forward Bradley Barcola; Reds set to pay £106m up front - and package could reach £123m By Vinny O'Connor Saturday 29 August 2026 09:37, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player What are the four things Liverpool fans should know about transfer target Bradley Barcola? Bradley Barcola is set sign a Liverpool contract to 2031 after the Premier League club reached agreement with PSG over the structure of the transfer. Sky Sports reported on Friday that an agreement in principle had been reached for Barcola to move to Anfield in a package worth £120m. The final discussions had centred over the structure of deal, with Liverpool now set to pay £106m up front and up to £17m in add-ons. Documents must still be exchanged between the clubs and Barcola must complete a medical, which is expected to take place this weekend. The English duo are tied 27th on three-under-par after Woad slipped back from a promising first round through a one-over 73 and Hull posted a two-under 70. But Corpuz shot a 67 to take a share of the lead with Japan's in-form Miyu Yamashita, last week's winner on the LPGA Tour, and Korea's Hyo Joo Kim on nine under. messages.text: Greaves denied by Cross in last-leg thriller on European Tour debut

metadata.summary: Beau Greaves took Rob Cross to a last-leg decider before losing out 6-5 on her European Tour debut in the first round of the Hungarian Darts Trophy.
metadata.content: Hungarian Darts Trophy: Beau Greaves just loses out to Rob Cross in last-leg decider on European Tour debut | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to content Hungarian Darts Trophy: Beau Greaves just loses out to Rob Cross in last-leg decider on European Tour debut Beau Greaves became the first woman to play in a PDC European Tour event after qualifying for the Budapest tournament last month; Greaves and Rob Cross both averaged over 100 in first-round match with Cross edging the deciding leg after errors from opponent when left with chance on 70 Saturday 29 August 2026 01:05, UK Image: Rob Cross and Beau Greaves delivered a stunning round-one contest in Hungary (Gabor Kiss/PDC Europe image) Beau Greaves took Rob Cross to a last-leg decider before losing out 6-5 on her European Tour debut in the first round of the Hungarian Darts Trophy. Rising star Greaves, 22, made history by becoming the first woman to compete in a PDC European Tour event after qualifying last month for both this weekend's tournament in Budapest and the Czech Darts Open in September. And she pushed the experienced Cross to a deciding 11th leg in a thrilling tie on Friday evening, averaging an impressive match-best of 104.88 and hitting five 180s.
